regime_context: China A-shares are in an extreme one-narrative, narrow-leadership state: Banks dominate with unrivaled rank, broad internal breadth (0.83), and trend durability, while only 2 of 22 themes are trend-gate 'eligible' and the rotation breadth fraction is just 0.09. The trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so the detector is display-only discipline here, and my directional read-through is modest.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the Banks one-narrative starts to crack: I would retire this watch if Banks' breadth (0.833) and durability stay above CSI 300's pace and no confirmed challenger becomes trend-gate eligible; I would upgrade it if coal or defense becomes eligible=true while Banks breadth drops below 0.6.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the one confirmed institutional narrative: top rank, trend-tagged Hurst, 0.83 breadth, and dominant one-narrative weight. The trend-gate leg shows it as the only eligible leader with a coherent trend, while coal (challenger) is ineligible. Given rank-IC is weak, this is a focus/leadership read, not a return forecast; crowding is high so I would only hold, not add aggressively.
evidence: rank 1 of 22 with score 0.653 and eligible=true
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting A-share tape whipsaws the trend gate on history, and extreme one-narrative concentration plus high crowding (z=1.72) makes Banks vulnerable to a sharp round-trip if any policy shock rotates money out of financials.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma is trend-gate eligible but its momentum score is moderate (0.38), its Hurst tag is mixed, and it is crowded (z=1.38) with only mid-pack rank. It sits in the shadow of the Banks one-narrative regime with nothing to independently fuel leadership; a mean-reverting tape argues against chasing a theme that is crowded but not dominant.
theses.dissent: Pharma has defensible absolute trend eligibility and could catch a rotation bid if Banks stall and healthcare policy headlines turn supportive.

falsifier.text: Pharma ETF 159992.SZ rallies 5% relative to CSI 300 over the horizon

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the nominal challenger in leader/challenger rotation, but it is trend-gate ineligible (false), has breadth of only 0.1, fragmented mixed Hurst tag, and the rotation breadth is narrow (0.09). A mean-reverting tape and a weak focus lens give no basis to lean into a fragile second-name.
evidence: rotation margin 0.143 vs Banks with absorption 0.37
theses.dissent: Coal could spike on an energy policy or supply shock given its macro 'energy' narrative thread, and its low crowding leaves room for fast entry.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS outperforms Banks 512800.SS by 3% within 10 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
